description: A reinforced particle shield defensive barrier and forcefield generator matrix enveloping a relativistic spacecraft. Multi-colored high-contrast energy shield designed to contrast starkly against black cosmic void: glowing radiant amber-gold hexagonal particle deflection lattices, vibrant pulsing cyan plasma emitter nodes, electric magenta dispersion waves, and emerald harmonic resonance bands. Low-to-mid poly triangle topology optimized for WebXR across mobile, desktop, VR, and ARCore.
texture_prompt: Vibrant multi-colored energy forcefield, luminous golden amber hexagonal particle grid, electric cyan emitter nodes, magenta harmonic waves, high contrast against pitch black space, translucent emissive PBR textures.
color_scheme: multi-colored high-contrast against black cosmic background (gold armor, cyan ion engines, emerald telemetry, violet phase)
